newsitem.title: USA: Businesses urge fewer border restrictions in APEC.
newsitem.headline: Businesses urge fewer border restrictions in APEC.

text.p: An APEC business advisory panel Thursday urged the 18-member trade group to reduce border restrictions that impede the flow of goods, services, information and capital and add to the cost of commerce.

A report to the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation forum by the Business Advisory Council, comprised of three companies from each of the member countries, urged creation of an APEC business visa to facilitate business-related travel.
